character.name:
Pixel art character of a Vietnamese soldier wearing a green uniform, red collar tabs, a green pith helmet with a five-pointed gold star , brown ammo pouches, and green boots. 
Retro 8-bit top-down 2D game style, simple clean background, transparent background.
